what's the difference between a copay an: A copay is a fixed amount you pay for a service, like $25 for a doctor visit. Coinsurance is different because it is a percentage of the cost, like 20 percent. Both are parts of what you pay when you use your insurance.
what does \"twice daily\" mean?: Twice daily means you take two doses in one day, spaced out. This often means one in the morning and one in the evening. It does not mean taking two tablets at once. If the label is unclear, please ask your pharmacist!
what is a screening?: A screening is a test for people who have no symptoms. It is done to help find a health problem early. You can ask your care team which screenings are right for you!
what should i ask about a new medicine?: When you get a new medicine, it is a great idea to ask what it is for and how to take it. You should also ask about which warning signs mean you should call your care team right away. Finally, ask what you should do if you happen to miss a dose.
